The remarkable transformation of India's power sector since 2014 is truly an awe-inspiring chronicle of progress, resilience & clean energy transition. Implementation of some of the world's largest power sector reforms including universal electrification, rapid expansion of renewable energy and smart energy infrastructure, highlight the country's pioneering new model of economic development that avoids the carbon-intensive approaches.

While the world at large remains at a decisive cross-road in its journey to tackle the climate crisis, and limiting the rise in global temperatures to 1.5°C; under the visionary leadership of Honourable Prime Minister Shri. Narendra Modi, India's climate mitigation targets are not just transformational for India but also provide a blueprint for the world to follow.

th As a part of the national statement delivered at the 26 Conference of the Parties (COP 26), the Prime Minister announced the landmark commitment to achieve carbon neutrality by 2070. A part of five-point action plan that included installing 500 gigawatts of renewable energy to meet 50% of India's by 2030, reducing the emissions intensity of its economy by 45%, and reducing a billion tonnes of CO2. As the world's fastest growing large economy with over 1.3 billion people, these reforms complemented by overwhelming support from the Indian and Global Power & Utility industry, would ensure reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy to its people.

Accelerating India's sustainable economic development however also require a total transformation of its energy systems. Significant strides will thus have to be made in transforming the economy from one dominated by fossil fuels into one powered predominantly by renewables; including commitment to enhance clean power generation, universal electrification, integration of smart grids, roll out of advanced metering infrastructure, digital transformation and demand response mechanisms.

With India's energy demands set to grow multi-fold in the coming decades, the enormous challenge of transforming India's energy systems is also a huge opportunity for its economy. Sustained investments, innovation, and collaboration will be key to further strengthening India's power sector and ensuring a brighter, more prosperous tomorrow for all its citizens.

Experience a new dimension of engagement at our Silent Conference, where cutting-edge technology meets impactful dialogue. With wireless headsets, attendees can seamlessly tune into simultaneous panels dedicated to Power Generation and Utility topics, ensuring a focused and immersive experience without external noise distractions.

The conference will bring together India's foremost energy leaders, policymakers, and innovators in a multi-track format, spotlighting India's journey toward decarbonization and grid modernization. Through high-level keynotes and interactive discussions, participants can explore critical themes, from renewable energy integration and digital grid resilience to strategies for clean energy investment.

This silent, tech-enabled format allows participants to switch between panels effortlessly, tailoring their experience to match their interests in the energy ecosystem. Join us to gain fresh insights, engage with industry peers, and take part in shaping India's sustainable and resilient energy future.
A CHANGING ENERGY MIXTURE

The Energy & Climate Initiatives Society (ENCIS) is pleased to announce the launch of Bharat Electricity – A landmark initiative to showcase the remarkable transformation of India's power sector over the last decade and host the environment for the global energy ecosystem stakeholders to explore, collaborate & access the unprecedented opportunities offered by India’s awe-inspiring chronicle of progress, resilience & clean energy transition!

A Global Energy Forum featuring world’s most forward-thinking policy makers, regulators, industry titans, thought leaders & experts sharing their unprecedented insights on navigating the challenges and opportunities in shaping a sustainable and resilient energy future for India and the world.
AN EVOLVING ENERGY MIX

India’s power generation sector was built on coal, but how the country generates its electricity is now undergoing a significant change. With an ambitious drive to decarbonise through a greater contribution from renewable energy and the resulting need for more operational flexibility by conventional assets, coupled with the shift towards more decentralisation of generation, India’s energy mix is evolving. Here, we discuss the key opportunities and issues in the generation sector borne from these changes.
A TRANSFORMING UTILITY SECTOR

India’s ambitious target for 450GW of installed renewable capacity by 2030 enhances the need for greater flexibility in the power system. With the rollout of 250 million smart meters underway and a forward looking e-mobility transition the digitalisation and adoption of new technologies across the energy sector is paramount. Here we will discuss the key opportunities and issues for the smart energy community.

blocks.text: When do I pay? On receiving your completed registration form, we will send an official confirmation and invoice within 3 days. Payment of the full delegate fee is due 14 days from the invoice date, or immediately with registration if the booking is made within one month of the event. In the event that payment has not been received before the start of the event, delegates will be asked to make the payment on-site or otherwise be refused entry. We recommend you check with your finance department that payment has been made before travelling to the conference.

Cancellation policy Cancellations made within 48 hours of receipt of the completed registration form will be eligible for a full refund. Cancellations received in writing more than two months prior to the start of the event will be refunded less a 50% cancellation fee. Cancellations received in writing less than two months before the start date of the event will receive no refund and registrants will be liable for payment of 100% of the invoiced amount. A substitute delegate can be named at any time before the event starts or a conference voucher valid for one year will be offered for the same value to use towards any other event organised by Synergy BV. No fees will be applied for this.
